title: Single Aerobic CSTR BOD Removal (ASM1)
description: Minimal IWA ASM1 municipal wastewater treatment plant with a single continuously stirred aerobic bioreactor and secondary settling clarifier for carbonaceous BOD removal.

title: Pre-Denitrification Anoxic-Aerobic Nitrification Loop
description: Modified Ludzack-Ettinger (MLE) ASM1 activated sludge configuration pairing an upstream anoxic denitrification tank with an aerated nitrification basin and 2.5x internal nitrate recycle.

title: Benchmark Simulation Model No. 1 (BSM1 5-Tank Plant)
description: Standard IWA/COST Benchmark Simulation Model No. 1 (BSM1) featuring two 1000 m3 anoxic tanks, three 1333 m3 aerated reactors, 3x internal recycle, and a 10-layer Takacs clarifier.

title: Enhanced Biological Phosphorus Removal (ASM2d)
description: A2O Enhanced Biological Phosphorus Removal (EBPR) plant modeled under IWA ASM2d with sequential anaerobic PAO release, anoxic denitrification, and aerobic luxury phosphorus uptake zones.

title: Dynamic Storm-Weather BSM1 WWTP with Influent Profile
description: Full-scale BSM1 municipal wastewater treatment plant configured for dry-weather and storm-surge hydraulic load testing alongside a 24-hour dynamic influent flow and COD/NH4 profile CSV.
